text:
Alex: Quick poll — bagels tomorrow? I can bring a dozen. Vote with emoji: :+1: plain, :heart: everything, :laughing: cinnamon. Who's in?
Priya: :heart: Everything bagel gang. Also quick kudos to Jordan for fixing the kettle yesterday :clap:
Jordan: I just wiggled the plug, nothing heroic. +1 for sesame + butter though.
Sam: Everything, hold the raw onion please. Also who nicked the red travel mug? :eyes:
Lina: Guilty. It looked lonely. Not returning until it learns to meditate. :sunglasses:
OpsBot: Reminder: kitchen fridge labeling policy updated — please tag leftovers with name + date. https://intra/docs/fridge-rules (automated)
Alex: Okay, looks like majority wants everything. Plan: 6 everything, 4 sesame, 2 plain? Any gluten-free requests?
Priya: One GF please, thanks Alex!
Jordan: Can we get butter + schmear options? Also @Lina owes me a coffee from the espresso-free-forum incident. :coffee:
Lina: Noted. Will bring a tiny French press and my apologies to Jordan (and the mug).
Sam: Tally so far: everything x4, sesame x2, plain x1, gf x1. Winner: everything. Thanks Alex! :tada:
Alex: Cool — I'll drop them off ~9:30. Also unrelated: who wants to join a 5-minute one-liner contest at 4pm? Loser brings croissant.
Priya: I'm in. Prepare to be underwhelmed.
Jordan: Will supply theatrical groans.
OpsBot: Heads-up: deploy scheduled at 03:00 UTC tonight — please avoid pushing unrelated infra changes in the hour prior. (automated)
Sam: One-liner theme suggestion: false advertising.
Lina: Perfect. See you at 4. Also reminder: label your stuff in the fridge or it will be rebranded as 'community assets'. :stew:
